create_s3vector_index: create an S3 vector index with specified dimension, data type, and distance metric
insert_vectors_collection: insert vector items into an S3 vector collection with metadata and text fields
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in an S3 vector collection using query vectors and a limit
delete_vectors_by_id: delete specific vectors from an S3 vector collection by their IDs
reset_s3vector_collection: reset all vector data by deleting all indexes in the S3 vector bucket
